claim: With input that includes a button press, the Guardian stayed in Tower North from 10:07 to 12:03 UTC; with all input stopped, the game returned it to orbit exactly 15 minutes after the last press (its normal idle rule)

Opening a vendor reaches the game's vendor code and finds the vendor; the screen itself is missing because the Tower runs under the story-mission menus. Presenting the Tower as its own activity was refused for missing permission. No visual evidence of the trace.
